faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications for the Indian Institute of Packaging (IIP) Recruitment 2026 for Packaging Designer, Technical Assistant posts is 18 August 2026. Candidates must ensure their applications reach the specified address by this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in IIP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies announced in the IIP Recruitment 2026. These positions are for Packaging Designer and Technical Assistant roles, with 2 vacancies for each post, offering opportunities in the research field.

faq.question: Q3. What are the eligibility criteria for Packaging Designer?
faq.answer: For Packaging Designer, candidates need a B.Des. with at least 2 years of experience or an M.Des. with at least 1 year of experience in product designing. Proficiency in design software like ArtiosCAD, Auto CAD, SolidWorks, CATIA is also required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Technical Assistant posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Technical Assistant post is 30 years. Age relaxation is applicable for OBC (up to 33 years) and SC/ST (up to 35 years) categories as per government norms, providing flexibility for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for Packaging Designer?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary for the Packaging Designer position in IIP Recruitment 2026 is Rs. 50,000/- per month. This is a contractual position based at the Indian Institute of Packaging's Head Office in Mumbai.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for IIP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for IIP Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, attach required documents, and send it via Registered Post or Speed Post to the specified address.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the job location for these posts?
faq.answer: The job location for the Packaging Designer, Technical Assistant posts is Mumbai, Maharashtra. Specifically, these contractual positions are at the Head office of the Indian Institute of Packaging, located in the MIDC Area Andheri East.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for IIP Recruitment 2026 involves two main stages. First, there will be an application screening based on essential qualifications and experience. Shortlisted candidates will then proceed to an interview round for final selection.

faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for the IIP Recruitment 2026. Candidates should refer to the official PDF for any updates or specific instructions regarding fees before submitting their application form.
